title: Kylo Ren
subtitle: We're Not Done Yet
text: Action [Exhaust]: Discard a card from your hand. If you discarded an upgrade this way, draw a card.
deployBox:
Sentinel

epicAction: Epic Action: If you control 7 or more resources, deploy this leader.
rules:
Abilities that let you play a card require you to pay that card’s cost unless specified otherwise.
For abilities that encompass multiple actions, resolve each action (and any resulting triggers) sequentially.
